title: Degree piece of the normal-cone residue fibre
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative local ring and let $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ be an ideal. Put $A=R/I$, $k=R/\mathfrak m$, and $F=k\otimes_A\operatorname{gr}_I R$, with its canonical residue-fibre initial classes $c_j(a)=1\otimes\iota_j(a\bmod I^{j+1})$ for $a\in I^j$ [def-trf-normal-cone-residue-fibre]. For each $j\in\mathbf N$, define the degree-$j$ vector subspace of $F$ by $F_j=\operatorname{span}_k\{c_j(a):a\in I^j\}$ [def-weil-submodule-span]. No Noetherianity, flatness, reducedness, characteristic or finite-dimensionality assumption is imposed.

source.place: Associated-graded construction, Section 00JM and proof of Lemma 05GH, followed by tensoring with the residue field. The degree-j piece is the k-span of 1 tensor the degree-j initial classes. Also Hironaka, Certain numerical characters of singularities (1970), section 2, p.153, normal-cone fibre construction, as cited in the existing Ideal.normalConeFibrePiece docstring. This node owns only the subspace construction, not the normal-flat Hilbert convolution theorem.
